hook: Oil climbed again to a $93.20 WTI close and Brent near $106, while stocks finished mixed on a bond-market holiday.

ticker.line: WTI Nov close $93.20 (Fri $91.85). Brent ~$106.04, highest close this month.
Bond market shut for Columbus Day. Last CMT Fri: 10y 5.24%. 2y 4.80%. 30y 5.60%.

watch: Whether WTI keeps climbing toward the $100 line.
Whether yields jump when bonds reopen after oil's rise.
Whether the S&P gets back above 7,818.93.
